description: Sources monitored by the GoOrganicAfrica agricultural data update engine.

sources.notes: The updater discovers the latest available NBS Food Price Watch ZIP, extracts the Excel tables and prepares candidate reference-price updates. Changes are proposed for review before publication.

Seed prices are deliberately modeled separately from commodity selling prices. Configure one or more reliable agro-dealer/cooperative/government feeds when a machine-readable source is available. Until then, the CMS remains the approval/override source.
FX is kept separate so future currency conversion can update without changing agronomic assumptions.
